en.headline: Tin Sum police station to become reporting centre from Sunday
en.dek: After the Tin Sum Division is merged into Sha Tin and Ma On Shan divisions, the Hin Keng Street report room will operate as a reporting centre from 8am to 10.30pm daily.
body: Police said the Tin Sum Division of the Sha Tin Police District will be merged into the Sha Tin Division and the Ma On Shan Division from Sunday, 30 August. From the same day, the Tin Sum Division Police Station Report Room at 2 Hin Keng Street, Sha Tin, will operate as the Tin Sum Reporting Centre.

The reporting centre's telephone number is 3661 1706. Police said it will be open from 8am to 10.30pm daily. The force said it would review the centre's operation and community needs before deciding on any further arrangements.

Members of the public may still report cases around the clock at the Sha Tin Division Police Station Report Room on 3661 1702 or the Ma On Shan Division Police Station Report Room on 3661 1700. Reports can also be made at a self-service kiosk or through the e-Report Centre on the police website and mobile application. In an emergency, the public should call 999.

zh.headline: 田心警署周日改為報案中心 服務至晚上10時半
zh.dek: 沙田警區田心分區周日併入沙田及馬鞍山分區後，顯徑街報案室將改為報案中心，每日上午8時至晚上10時半開放。
body: 警方表示，沙田警區田心分區將於周日（8月30日）併入沙田分區及馬鞍山分區。同日起，位於沙田顯徑街2號的田心分區警署報案室將改為田心報案中心運作。
報案中心電話為3661 1706，開放時間為每日上午8時至晚上10時30分。警方表示會定期檢視報案中心運作及社區需要，再作進一步安排。
市民仍可全日24小時到沙田分區警署報案室（3661 1702）或馬鞍山分區警署報案室（3661 1700）報案，亦可使用自助報案亭，或經警方網站及流動應用程式的電子報案中心提交報告。遇緊急事故應致電999。
